info.name: Nivesh v4 API Collection
info.description:
Postman v2.1 collection for all v4 new and modified endpoints.

14 new endpoints (B.1–B.14) + 10 modified endpoints (C.1–C.10) per docs/api-changes.md.

All changes are additive — no existing endpoint shapes were broken.

## Auth
Set the `session_token` collection variable to your cookie value.
Get one via: GET https://staging.niveshcopilot.com/api/auth/dev-set-cookie?token=<token>

## Base URL
Default: staging.niveshcopilot.com (staging)
Swap BASE_URL variable for prod (niveshcopilot.com).

variable.description: Base URL — swap to https://niveshcopilot.com for prod
Session token cookie value (aporwal107@gmail.com preview session)
MFD profile ID for advisor-scoped endpoints
Async task ID for polling review-pack status

item.name: Dashboards (v4)
item.description:
Six composite dashboard endpoints — screens 04 Concentration, 05 Diversification, 06 Risk, 07 Performance, 08 Goals, 09 Tax.

Each returns a unified envelope: { type, badge, insight, stat_tiles, breakdown, recommendations, projection, etag }.

Single fetch per screen; composes domain service + active plan filtered by source_domain + health-projection delta (≤3 DB queries).

See api-changes.md §B.1 for the full response schema.

query.description: Breakdown lens: sector | amc | company | group

request.description:
Screen 04 — Concentration dashboard composite.

Returns unified envelope with sector/amc/company/group breakdown, HHI, Effective-N, top5_pct, caution_pct (25%), and up to 3 ranked recommendations with source_domain=concentration.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.1, Decision 1.

query.description: Breakdown lens: overlap | stocks | category | asset_mix

request.description:
Screen 05 — Diversification dashboard composite.

Returns fund overlap matrix, unique_stocks_count, asset-mix breakdown, and recommendations with source_domain=diversification.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.1, §C.6.

Screen 06 — Risk dashboard composite.

Includes weighted_beta, weighted_volatility, max_drawdown_pct, var_1d_rs, var_1d_pct (95% confidence), risk_drivers list, and recommendations with source_domain=risk.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.1, §C.3.

Screen 07 (Performance tab) — Performance dashboard composite.

Includes portfolio XIRR, benchmark alpha (peer and index), fund-level performance breakdown, and recommendations with source_domain=performance.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.1, §C.7.

Screen 08 — Goals dashboard composite.

Includes per-goal progress (funding_pp), at-risk flag, SIP recommendations with priority_label='Closes the gap'/'Closes most'/'Partial', and exclusive=true actions.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.1, Decision 6.

Screen 09 — Tax dashboard composite.

Includes LTCG limit (₹1.25L per Jul-2024 law), ltcg_used_rs, ltcg_remaining_rs, harvest candidates, days_to_fy_end, and recommendations with source_domain=tax and reason_codes=[TAX_HARVEST].

Ref: api-changes.md §B.1, §B.12, Decision 6.

item.name: Recommendations (v4)
item.description:
Screened investment ideas for stocks and funds — screen 07 Recommendations tab.

Nivesh proxies NIDP screening engine (/v1/stocks/scores/, /v1/mf/scores/) and surfaces results with SEBI compliance note.

See api-changes.md §B.13 and §B.14.

query.description: Risk profile: conservative | balanced | growth (defaults to user's risk_profile if omitted)

request.description:
Screen 07 — Top stock ideas, NIDP-screened.

Returns ranked list with composite_score, fundamentals, technicals sub-scores, and a mandatory SEBI compliance_note.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.13.

query.description: Risk profile filter: conservative | moderate | growth

request.description:
Screen 07 — Top fund ideas, NIDP-screened.

Returns ranked list with composite_score and returns/cost/consistency sub-scores.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.14.

item.name: Advisor (v4)
item.description:
Advisor book and SIP board aggregations — screens 15 Advisor Book and 17 SIP Board (advisor).

All endpoints require an advisor session. Impersonation context (POST /api/mfd/profiles/{id}/activate) is NOT needed for these aggregate views — they operate over the advisor's entire book.

See api-changes.md §B.6, §B.7, §B.8.

request.description:
Screen 15 — Advisor Book top stat row.

Returns book_aum_rs, avg_health_score, needs_attention_count, actions_open_count, clients_total.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.6.

query.description: Filter by queue: failed | expiring | step_up | healthy (default: all four returned grouped)

request.description:
Screen 17 — SIP board queue list (advisor).

Returns { cycle, queues: { failed, expiring, step_up, healthy } } where each queue is a list of SipBoardRow objects.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.7.

Screen 17 — SIP board top stat row.

Returns monthly_inflow_rs, active_sips_count, failed_count, mandate_at_risk_count for the current cycle.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.8.

item.name: MFD (v4)
item.description:
Per-client MFD workspace endpoints — screen 16 Client 360 (advisor).

All endpoints require an advisor session. The profile_id path parameter identifies the client.

See api-changes.md §B.3, §B.4, §B.5, §B.9.

request.description:
Screen 16 — Client needs-attention list.

Returns items[] from plan_actions joined with insights filtered by severity >= HIGH. Each item includes item_id, title, subtitle, source_domain, severity, discuss_status, linked_action_id.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.3.

Screen 16 — Log a call CTA.

Creates a CRM call-log entry. Returns call_log_id and occurred_at.

Outcome values: callback_requested | discussed_rebalance | no_answer | left_voicemail

Ref: api-changes.md §B.5.

Screen 17 — Message client CTA (SIP Board advisor).

Queues a template-based nudge message to the client (no LLM in critical path). Returns nudge_id and queued_at.

Templates: BOUNCE_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE | BOUNCE_MANDATE_LIMIT | BOUNCE_ACCOUNT_CLOSED | MANDATE_EXPIRY | STEPUP_DUE

Ref: api-changes.md §B.9.

Screen 16 — Prepare review pack CTA.

Kicks off async PDF generation. Returns task_id (status=QUEUED, estimated_seconds=15). Poll GET /review-pack/{task_id} for completion and download_url.

Sections: portfolio | goals | risk | performance | health | domains | needs_attention | plan

Ref: api-changes.md §B.4.

Screen 16 — Poll review pack generation status.

Returns { task_id, status, download_url? }. Status values: QUEUED | PROCESSING | COMPLETED | FAILED.

Poll every 2-5s until status leaves QUEUED/PROCESSING.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.4.

item.name: Intelligence (v4)
item.description:
Client 360 intelligence rollup — screen 12 Intelligence 360.

Composites v3-portfolio + tax-summary + goals/snapshot into a 6-domain advisor view.

Requires advisor session + active impersonation context (POST /api/mfd/profiles/{id}/activate first).

See api-changes.md §B.2.

request.description:
Screen 12 / Screen 16 — Client 360 6-domain intelligence rollup.

Returns: client meta (aum, style, risk_profile, last_seen_days), health (score, grade, tone), domains[] (6 scores), needs_attention[], actions[].

Requires POST /api/mfd/profiles/{id}/activate to set impersonation context first.

Ref: api-changes.md §B.2.

item.name: Modified Endpoints (v4)
item.description:
Endpoints that existed in v1/v3 and have been additively extended for v4.

All changes are backward-compatible — existing callers ignore new fields.

Covers: C.7 fund-performance benchmark params, C.8 portfolio-builder slider fields, C.9 SIP state/mandate fields, C.2 v3-portfolio ETag, C.1 plans source_domain filter, Decision 6 snapshot activation writers.

See api-changes.md §C for full before/after schemas.

query.description: Benchmark type: peer | index (default peer — backward compat)

request.description:
Screen 10 (Performance tab) — Fund-level performance with benchmark alpha.

New query params: ?period=1y|3y|5y and ?benchmark=peer|index.
New response fields: alpha_3y_benchmark_pp, benchmark_index per fund.

Existing ?period=1y&benchmark=peer default preserves backward compat.

Ref: api-changes.md §C.7.

Screen 14 — Portfolio builder with v4 slider inputs.

New fields (all additive, all defaulted):
- monthly_surplus_rs: slider value (defaults to monthly_sip_rs)
- horizon_years: goal horizon slider (defaults to profile-derived)
- risk_bucket: risk slider override (defaults to user.risk_profile)

New response field: cap_pct per instrument (guardrail for client rendering).

Ref: api-changes.md §C.8.

Screen 13 SIP Board (investor) — SIP list with v4 state/mandate/bounce fields.

New additive fields per SIP: state (failed|expiring|step_up|healthy), mandate_id, mandate_expiry_date, last_bounce_reason, last_bounce_date, cycles_missed, next_debit_date, proposed_stepup_pct.

Ref: api-changes.md §C.9.

Screens 01 Homepage, 02 Health Score — v3 portfolio insights with ETag.

New additions:
- Response header: ETag: "sha1:<hash>" (hash of score + grade)
- Response body: health.grade_band (4-band: A/B/C/D) alongside existing 7-band health.grade
- Response body: health.low_confidence bool

Plan Board uses ETag to detect score-shift on action accept.

Ref: api-changes.md §C.2, Decision 5.

query.description: Filter actions by origin domain: concentration | diversification | risk | performance | goals | tax

request.description:
Screen 03 Plan Board — active plan with server-side source_domain filter.

New query param: ?source_domain= pushes domain filtering server-side (was done client-side in V3 frontend).

New additive action fields: verb, priority_label, impact, effort, trade_off, expected_impact, source_domain, exclusive, scores, switch_target.

Ref: api-changes.md §C.1.

Screens 08 Goals, 09 Tax — Snapshot activation now fires tax + goals action writers.

Post-activation hook (Decision 6) reads tax_harvest candidates and goal-engine recommendations, then writes plan_actions rows with source_domain=tax/goals so Plan Board is pre-populated without extra navigation.

Goals actions are written with exclusive=true (PRD §7.4 mutual exclusion).

Ref: api-changes.md Decision 6.
